head: ba389d3 Add InCallService and acoustic audio bridge

findings.title: PJSIP AAR ships only arm64-v8a native libraries
findings.consequence: On a device whose ro.product.cpu.abilist has no arm64-v8a (Redmi 9C stock MIUI is reported as 32-bit userspace) the APK fails to install or crashes with UnsatisfiedLinkError. PJSIP must be rebuilt for armeabi-v7a.

findings.title: android.permission.CAPTURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT is signature|privileged
findings.consequence: Cannot be granted to a user-installed app on an unrooted phone; 'adb shell pm grant' rejects it. Code paths depending on it are dead.

findings.title: android.permission.MODIFY_PHONE_STATE is signature|privileged
findings.consequence: Cannot be granted to a user-installed app on an unrooted phone; 'adb shell pm grant' rejects it. Code paths depending on it are dead.

findings.title: README documents system-app install on a rooted device
findings.consequence: The authors' own intended deployment for full functionality is root/system-app.

findings.title: Call-audio capture falls back to the microphone on unrooted devices
findings.consequence: Without CAPTURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT the bridge records the physical MIC. Per Android 10 audio-input sharing policy, during a cellular call an ordinary app's capture is silenced unless it is an accessibility service.

findings.title: No AccessibilityService in the app
findings.evidence: No AccessibilityService class or manifest declaration found
findings.consequence: On Android 10 the only documented non-privileged way to capture mic audio during a voice call is an accessibility service. As written, GSM->SIP audio is expected to be silence on an unrooted Redmi 9C (must be confirmed on device: test T3).

findings.title: Audio bridge is acoustic (speakerphone -> microphone), not line-level
findings.evidence: SipAudioBridge.kt: GSM downlink -> speaker -> mic; SIP audio -> AudioTrack(USAGE_MEDIA) -> speaker -> mic -> GSM uplink; AEC and NS explicitly disabled
findings.consequence: Both directions pass through a cheap speaker and mic in open air: echo, room noise, feedback, the AI hears its own TTS, and the modem's in-call echo canceller may remove the injected TTS from the uplink. Not acceptable for commercial call quality.

findings.title: Bridge runs at 8 kHz L16 (narrowband)
findings.consequence: STT accuracy (esp. Urdu) is limited by narrowband audio.

findings.title: Call control uses default-dialer InCallService + TelecomManager.placeCall
findings.consequence: Answer / place / hang up work without root if the app is the default phone app. The app never requests ROLE_DIALER; the user must set it manually, and MIUI may override it.

findings.title: SIP server stack is Docker Compose with public UDP ports and a privileged container
findings.consequence: Colab has no Docker daemon and no inbound UDP. Cloudflare Tunnel carries HTTP/TCP, not SIP-over-UDP or RTP. Kamailio/RTPEngine/coturn need a VPS with a public IP.
